notes: Clauses about life span, death, named diseases and physical defects are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy; affected rules list them in 'dropped'.

rules.text: The 11th lord in the 11th, an angle or a trine, or exalted (even if combust): many gains.
The 11th lord in the 2nd, the 2nd lord in an angle and Jupiter in the 11th: immense gains.

variants.text: The 11th lord in the 3rd with benefics in the 11th: a substantial gain (the text times it around the 36th year).
The 11th lord with a benefic in an angle or trine: a gain around the 40th year.
Jupiter in the 11th, the Moon in the 2nd and Venus in the 9th: considerable wealth.

rules.text: Jupiter with Mercury and the Moon in the 9th: wealth, provisions, fortune, jewels and ornaments.
The ascendant and 11th lords exchange houses: a substantial gain (the text times it around the 33rd year).
The 2nd and 11th lords exchange houses: a great rise in fortune after marriage.
The 3rd and 11th lords exchange houses: gains through siblings and fine ornaments.
The 11th lord debilitated, combust, or with a malefic in the 6th, 8th or 12th: little gain despite great effort.
